prompts.prompt:
The visual shows a Connect Four board in a midgame position with red and yellow discs. Using the visible column labels, select the column whose red-disc count is 2 and yellow-disc count is 3.
Annotation format: set "annotation" to a JSON array of pixel-space cell boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for the occupied cells in the selected column.
Answer format: set "answer" to the selected column label as a capital letter shown below the board.
Example JSON:
{"annotation":[[140,220,190,270],[140,290,190,340]],"answer":"C"}

The visual shows a Connect Four board in a midgame position with red and yellow discs. Using the visible column labels, select the column whose red-disc count is 2 and yellow-disc count is 3.
Answer format: set "answer" to the selected column label as a capital letter shown below the board.
Example JSON:
{"answer":"C"}

The visual shows a Connect Four board in a crowded late-game position with red and yellow discs. It is Red's turn. A legal drop chooses one non-full column and lands in its lowest empty square. A horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line of four matching discs wins. How many columns give Red an immediate win on this move?
Required annotation format: set "annotation" to a JSON array of pixel-space cell boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for every immediate-winning landing square.
Required answer format: set "answer" to the number of legal drop columns that win immediately.
Example JSON:
{"annotation":[[140,220,190,270],[210,220,260,270],[280,220,330,270]],"answer":3}

The visual shows a Connect Four board in a crowded late-game position with red and yellow discs. It is Red's turn. A legal drop chooses one non-full column and lands in its lowest empty square. A horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line of four matching discs wins. How many columns give Red an immediate win on this move?
Format for the "answer" field: set "answer" to the number of legal drop columns that win immediately.
Example JSON:
{"answer":3}

The scene shows a lane-crossing game board with moving objects and direction arrows. How many moving objects have arrows pointing left?
Required annotation format: set "annotation" to a JSON array of pixel-space object boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1], one for every moving object whose arrow points left.
Required answer format: set "answer" to the number of moving objects whose arrow points left; the value is between 1 and 6.
Example JSON:
{"annotation":[[190,285,258,330],[520,406,588,451]],"answer":2}

The image shows labeled candidate path cards, each showing a two-lane track with hazard cells and one candidate path. Each path moves one row toward the finish. A safe path never enters a hazard cell. Select the path label that avoids all hazard cells.
Required annotation format: set "annotation" to one bounding box [x0,y0,x1,y1] around the selected path card.
Required answer format: set "answer" to the selected path label as a capital letter.
Example JSON:
